title: #231 Hometown Change
prompt: Imagine one day that you have the power to change one thing in your hometown. What will you change? Please give specific reasons to support your answer.

promptSegments.text: Imagine one day that you have the power to change one thing in your hometown.
Please give specific reasons to support your answer.

A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Improving the local park makes the community better.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Improving the local park makes the community better.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Better schools help the whole community.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Better schools help the whole community.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first change would be to improve local parks by adding more trees and better play areas, as the current equipment is old and unsafe, discouraging families from spending time there.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first change would be to improve local parks by adding more trees and better play areas, as the current equipment is old and unsafe, discouraging families from spending time there.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second change would be to improve the local transportation system because the bus routes are slow and do not cover all areas, forcing people to walk long distances.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second change would be to improve the local transportation system because the bus routes are slow and do not cover all areas, forcing people to walk long distances.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary point is the necessity of improving green spaces and urban planning to enhance community well-being.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary point is the necessity of improving green spaces and urban planning to enhance community well-being.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The secondary point is the importance of upgrading transportation infrastructure and public safety to ensure a functional and secure local environment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The secondary point is the importance of upgrading transportation infrastructure and public safety to ensure a functional and secure local environment.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: To address the prompt by focusing on the most impactful change to improve the hometown's livability and community spirit through enhancing green spaces.
outline: Introduction: Present the scenario and state the chosen change.
Body 1: Explain the importance of green spaces in urban areas.
Body 2: Discuss the specific improvements to be made in the park.
Conclusion: Summarize the benefits and express hope for the future of the hometown.
keyArguments: Green spaces improve environmental sustainability and community well-being.
Enhancing a local park can mitigate urban decay and foster a sense of belonging.
